value.title: Bayani's Clue Hunt
value.instructions: Open all three clues above. Then use them together to choose the best answer.
value.question: What can these clues help us conclude about this story community?
choices: People shared relationships and responsibilities in a community.
Every barangay had exactly the same houses and customs.
These clues tell us every rule followed by every family.
value.correctAnswer: People shared relationships and responsibilities in a community.
value.correctExplanation: Yes! The clues show people living together and sharing parts of community life. This is a fictional learning scene, so it cannot prove that every real barangay was exactly the same.
